metaDescription: Order custom Callaway golf polo shirts in bulk. Great for corporate events and team uniforms. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Callaway golf polo shirts bring the same performance engineering found in their top-selling Supersoft golf balls to your team’s wardrobe. Moisture-wicking fabric, a self-fabric collar, and a three-button placket make these polos suitable for both the course and the office. Ideal for corporate golf outings, sales teams, or employee uniforms, they accept screen printing or embroidery without losing their tailored fit. Order in bulk to keep your brand consistent across every event.
heroAltText: Custom Callaway golf polo shirts with embroidered logo on left chest, moisture-wicking fabric, available in bulk.
